test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The length, breadth and height of a room are in the ratio 3 : 2 : 1. If the breadth and height are each reduced to half their original values while the length is doubled, find the percentage change (rounded off to two decimal places) in the total surface area of the room.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take ratio values: l = 3, b = 2, h = 1

Original TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(6 + 2 + 3) = 22

New dimensions: l = 6, b = 1, h = 0.5

New TSA = 2(6 + 0.5 + 3) = 19

**∴ Answer = 13.64% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length : Breadth : Height = 3 : 2 : 1

Length doubled, Breadth and Height reduced to half

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let l = 3x, b = 2x, h = x

⇒ Original TSA = 2[(3x × 2x) + (2x × x) + (x × 3x)]

⇒ = 2(6x² + 2x² + 3x²)

⇒ = 2(11x²) = 22x²

⇒ New dimensions: l = 6x, b = x, h = x/2

⇒ New TSA = 2[(6x × x) + (x × x/2) + (x/2 × 6x)]

⇒ = 2(6x² + 0.5x² + 3x²)

⇒ = 2(9.5x²) = 19x²

⇒ Change = 19x² − 22x² = −3x²

⇒ % change = (−3x² ÷ 22x²) × 100

⇒ = −13.64%

**∴ The correct answer is 13.64% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area Formula

TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Ratio Method

Use proportional values (like 3, 2, 1) to simplify calculations

Scaling Concept

Changing dimensions changes area non-linearly

Percentage Change

% change = (New − Old) ÷ Old × 100
